nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Hilbert space and $T$ a compact normal operator on $E$. Then there are a Hilbert basis $(b_i)_{i \in I}$ of $E$ and complex numbers $(\mu_i)_{i \in I}$ such that $T b_i = \mu_i b_i$ for every $i$, and the eigenvalues vanish at infinity: for every $\varepsilon > 0$ the set of $i$ with $|\mu_i| \ge \varepsilon$ is finite.
